Platform konten perusahaan dengan isolas: Enterprise content platform with per-tenant data isolation, modular RBAC, and a structured publishing flow built on a Laravel + Vue architecture.
Satu basis kode melayani banyak klien pe: One codebase serves many enterprise clients — each tenant has its own data space, user management with role-based access control, and a structured editorial workflow from draft to publication.
Isolasi data per tenant dalam satu basis: Per-tenant data isolation in one codebase
Alur publikasi terstruktur: draf → revie: Structured publishing flow: draft → review → publish
Audit trail aktivitas & riwayat revisi k: Activity audit trail & content revision history
Banyak klien berbagi satu instalasi apli: Many clients share a single application installation without breaching each other's data. Every tenant needs its own content space, users, and configuration.

Setiap perubahan konten melewati alur re: Every content change goes through a review flow before going live, is recorded as revision history, and can be audited at any time.
